statement: No stock or availability status was rendered for any of the listed NVIDIA data-center and workstation cards on the ASA Computers page.
why: Missing availability text means the listed prices cannot be read as evidence that the parts are actually in stock and shippable.

impact.mechanism: Absence of stock status limits what the reseller price level can say about physical channel availability of merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: No explicit stock/availability status text was rendered on the page for these items.

confidence.basis: Directly observable absence on a single reseller page; absence of text is not proof of unavailability.
